summary: E-commerce product listing app with Indian Rupee pricing and Amazon shopping integration.
known_issues: Rupee price amounts displaying without decimals (e.g., 139900 instead of 1399.00)

existing_features.title: Fix the Rupee price display in the ProductGrid component (and any other product card/listing components) so that prices are correctly formatted with decimals. Prices stored as integers (e.g., 139900 representing paise) must be divided by 100 and displayed with 2 decimal places using the Indian Rupee symbol (e.g., Rs.1,399.00). Ensure this fix is applied consistently wherever product prices are rendered across the application.

Change the 'Shop on Amazon' button color to soft pink for every product card in the ProductGrid component and any other location where this button appears. Use a soft/light pink color (e.g., bg-pink-300 or similar Tailwind soft pink shade) for the button background, ensuring readable text contrast and hover state consistency.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix Rupee price display to show correct decimal format (e.g., Rs.1399.00 instead of 139900) for all products
Change 'Shop on Amazon' button color to soft pink for every product
